title: Primary Chinese: reading comprehension
description: Four lessons from context clues to inference: word meaning, sentence order, paragraph main idea, and inferring the author’s intent.
assumptions: Short passages with whole-text evidence; answers justified by the text, not outside knowledge.
stage1goal: Build meaning from context and order.
stage2goal: Summarize and infer beyond the literal.
word-meaning.title: Context clues for word meaning
word-meaning.goal: Use surrounding text to infer a word’s meaning.
word-meaning.reading: The sentence around a new word often explains it: “He was famished, so he ate three bowls.” Famished means very hungry.
word-meaning.worked.prompt: How does “ate three bowls” help you guess “famished”?
word-meaning.worked.fb: Eating a lot implies very hungry.
word-meaning.worked.content: “He was famished, so he ate three bowls.” The result shows hunger.
word-meaning.clue.prompt: “The room was chaotic: toys everywhere.” Chaotic means…
word-meaning.clue.a.label: messy
word-meaning.clue.b.label: quiet
word-meaning.independent.prompt: “She whispered, so nobody heard.” Whispered means…
word-meaning.independent.a.label: shouted
word-meaning.independent.b.label: spoke very quietly
word-meaning.c1.prompt: “He was exhausted after the race.” Exhausted means…
word-meaning.c1.a.label: very tired
word-meaning.c1.b.label: excited
sentence-order.title: Order sentences into a story
sentence-order.goal: Order sentences by time and cause.
sentence-order.reading: A story flows by time and cause: first seed, then sprout, then flower. Connectors like “then/finally” mark order.
sentence-order.worked.content: Seed → sprout → flower is the growth order.
sentence-order.order.f.label: flower
sentence-order.order.s.label: seed
sentence-order.order.p.label: sprout
sentence-order.transfer-order.prompt: Order: finally we ate / then we cooked / first we bought.
sentence-order.transfer-order.e.label: finally we ate
sentence-order.transfer-order.c.label: then we cooked
sentence-order.transfer-order.b.label: first we bought
sentence-order.c1.prompt: Which connector marks the last step?
sentence-order.c1.a.label: first
sentence-order.c1.b.label: finally
paragraph-main.title: Find the paragraph main idea
paragraph-main.goal: Distinguish main idea from supporting details.
paragraph-main.reading: The main idea covers the whole paragraph; details support it. Ask: what do all sentences talk about?
paragraph-main.struggle: Without listing details, explain how to find the main idea of a paragraph.
paragraph-main.worked.prompt: Why is “dogs help people” the main idea, not “dogs guide the blind”?
paragraph-main.worked.fb: Guiding is one example; helping covers all examples.
paragraph-main.worked.content: Sentences: guide blind, sniff drugs, comfort kids. All = dogs help people.
paragraph-main.main.prompt: Paragraph: bees pollinate flowers, make honey, feed bees. Main idea?
paragraph-main.main.a.label: Bees are useful
paragraph-main.main.b.label: Bees make honey
paragraph-main.transfer-main.prompt: Paragraph: rain fills rivers, waters crops, cools air. Main idea?
paragraph-main.transfer-main.a.label: Rain cools air
paragraph-main.transfer-main.b.label: Rain helps life
paragraph-main.c1.a.label: cover the whole paragraph
paragraph-main.c1.b.label: list every detail
infer-intent.title: Infer the author’s intent
infer-intent.goal: Infer why the author wrote, beyond the literal.
infer-intent.reading: Intent is inferred from tone and choice of details: praising, warning, or informing. Ask: what does the author want me to feel or do?
infer-intent.worked.prompt: Why does listing harms imply a warning?
infer-intent.worked.content: “Sugar rots teeth, adds weight.” The harms warn against sugar.
infer-intent.intent.prompt: “Recycle: cans become bikes, paper becomes boxes.” Intent?
infer-intent.intent.a.label: Encourage recycling
infer-intent.intent.b.label: Warn against bikes
infer-intent.transfer-intent.prompt: “The forest quieted; only axes echoed.” Intent?
infer-intent.transfer-intent.a.label: Praise logging
infer-intent.transfer-intent.b.label: Mourn loss of forest
infer-intent.c1.a.label: the title only
infer-intent.c1.b.label: tone and detail choices
infer-intent.c2.a.label: encourages
infer-intent.c2.b.label: warns
